key_highlights: ASX slumped as bond yields spiked and unemployment hit a 5-year high, signalling stagflationary pressure
RBA expected to hike again despite deteriorating labour market, testing credibility and inflation control
AUD 'pulverised' by US economic boom; Trump diesel export ban poses supply-chain risk to Australian energy
Mining exploration positive: Rio2 Peruvian copper drill, Auric high-grade gold at Munda, Sarytogan 452m copper intercept, Forrestania 210k oz gold resource
Property market cooling: rising listings, falling demand, over half of renters financially stressed
Intergenerational Report 2026 flags urgent tax reform need; energy cost politics intensify
Jetstar industrial action escalates with staff waiving fees; consumer sector under pressure

sectors.trend: Exploration momentum strong across copper and gold; Rio2 Peruvian drill, Auric Munda high-grade gold, Sarytogan 452m copper, Forrestania 210k oz gold, Lindian rare earths nearing production. However, Chinese property recovery uncertainty and global demand softness cap upside.
sectors.implications: Junior miners (AUR.AX, MAN.AX, FOR.AX, LND.AX) see catalyst-driven rallies; majors (BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX) face mixed iron ore/copper demand signals. Rare earths (LND.AX) gain strategic premium.

sectors.trend: RBA hiking into rising unemployment pressures NIMs but raises credit-loss risk. Bond yield spike compresses equity valuations. Intergenerational Report flags fiscal tightening ahead.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face margin tailwinds from higher rates but asset-quality headwinds from stressed renters and property softening. Defensive dividend appeal intact.

sectors.trend: Fuel price fears as global buffers dry up; Trump diesel export ban threatens Australian supply; nuclear energy debate intensifies; Labor energy cost credibility questioned.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WES.AX, SXG.AX benefit from fuel price volatility; LNG names (WDS.AX, BHP.AX) gain from energy security narrative. Nuclear policy shift could create long-term capex opportunities.

sectors.trend: Jetstar industrial action escalates; EV disruption (Bentley $325k EV, Chinese 5-min battery) pressures traditional auto; Ozempic boom reshaping food demand; renter stress constrains discretionary spend.
sectors.implications: QAN.AX faces operational disruption; WES.AX, WOW.AX under margin pressure from input costs; CSL.AX benefits from GLP-1 drug demand.

sectors.trend: AI data breach prompts NSW caution; US online safety intervention; Nine leadership reshuffle; Sandisk AI storage boom; crypto ETFs surging.
sectors.implications: W1.AX faces governance scrutiny; ASX-listed tech remains thin; global AI capex cycle (SNDK) supports hardware demand but Australian exposure limited.

sectors.trend: Rising listings, falling demand, and falling prices signal structural cooling; over half of renters financially stressed; Chinese property recovery uncertain.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX, DGL.AX) face occupancy and yield pressure; mortgage lenders (CBA.AX, ANZ.AX) monitor NPL migration.

key_themes: Stagflation risk: RBA hiking into 5-year high unemployment
AUD weakness vs USD driven by US economic outperformance
Trump trade/export policy disrupting Australian energy and commodity flows
Mining exploration renaissance in copper and gold
Energy security and nuclear policy debate
Consumer stress: renter affordability, Jetstar industrial action, fuel costs

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA rate hike into rising unemployment (stagflation)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight quality dividend payers; reduce duration in fixed income; hedge with gold (GOLD.AX, NVG.AX)

risk_assessment.risk_factor: AUD depreciation and Trump export restrictions
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge USD exposure; favour export-oriented miners with USD revenue; monitor diesel supply chains

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Property market correction and renter stress
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight residential REITs; monitor bank NPL data; favour industrial/infrastructure REITs

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Energy supply disruption (fuel buffers, diesel ban)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight integrated energy (WDS.AX, BHP.AX LNG); monitor AEMO capacity

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Jetstar industrial action / consumer transport disruption
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid QAN.AX short-term; monitor Qantas group earnings guidance
Prepare for potential GST or capital gains changes; favour cash-flow-generative equities

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and copper exploration names on positive drill results
opportunities.rationale: Auric Munda high-grade gold, Sarytogan 452m copper, Forrestania 210k oz, Rio2 Peruvian copper create near-term catalysts; gold hedges stagflation

opportunities.recommendation: Add quality bank dividends as defensive yield play amid rate hikes
opportunities.rationale: RBA hiking supports NIMs; 5-year high unemployment limits credit losses near-term; banks offer 6-7% yields

opportunities.recommendation: Position in integrated energy for fuel price volatility and nuclear policy shift
opportunities.rationale: Global buffer depletion, Trump diesel ban, and nuclear debate create multi-year structural tailwind

opportunities.recommendation: Rare earths exposure via Lindian as Malawian production nears
opportunities.rationale: Strategic mineral supply chain diversification; China dependency risk premium

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce residential REIT and property developer exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Rising listings, falling demand, renter stress signal structural correction; Chinese property recovery unconfirmed

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD weakness with USD-denominated assets or forward contracts
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD 'pulverised' by US boom; Trump policy adds volatility; export revenue miners partially hedge

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid QAN.AX and consumer discretionary into industrial action and renter stress
defensive_moves.rationale: Jetstar fee waivers signal margin pressure; consumer spending constrained by affordability crisis

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain cash or short-duration bonds as bond yields spike
defensive_moves.rationale: Yield spike creates capital loss risk in long bonds; RBA hiking cycle not over

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. ASX under pressure from bond yield spike, 5-year high unemployment, AUD weakness, and RBA hawkish stance. Stagflation narrative dominates. Mining exploration names provide selective pockets of strength. Expect volatility around RBA communications and US policy headlines.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive for quality resources and energy. Nuclear policy shift, rare earths supply chain, and copper/gold exploration pipeline support 12-month upside for select miners. Fiscal tightening via Intergenerational Report may cap broad market multiples. Property correction likely to continue 6-9 months.

Trump diesel export ban implementation timeline

Iron ore and copper spot prices
Jetstar QAN.AX share price and industrial relations
Trump trade policy / diesel export ban
AEMO energy capacity and fuel buffer levels
